transcript_segments.text: 2 bodies and a quiet bind One defines the frame of time
I trace a curve I never chose
Held and pass your mask composed
I was given last hold, less inertia in my role
Every step I try to take turns around you heavy
You wake, you don't move the way I do
You just start and die a crew
Every shift and every bend
As if you were origin I revolve
You remain, center drifts but not for me
I translate you just be
I circle with the balance lanes closer and not just between
Every arc I try to claim falls back into your domain
And I'll buy four-cycle resist Just buy scale, buy what persists
I am pulled into the proof of how much I depend on you
There's a center we both trace I do deep within your space
I can map it, I can see it's not place for symmetry
You define the common ground, our distress will fall around every cycle that I keep
Brights in aim and where I sweep you don't chase
You don't strain, master's sight
What aligns, I adjust every time
I circle with the balance lanes never equal, never clean
Every path I try to hold it'll store your manifold
Not devotion, not a choice just the shape of lesser force
I'm the echo of a frame that was never set the same
You don't need to move, to keep me moving
You don't need to call, I'm already falling
What we share is not divided, it's weighted
What if center isn't mutual just inherited it?
I begin to feel the strain revolving in your name
Not a prison, not a fraud just a fundamental law
If I slip that from your spoon you'd forget I'd ever been
But if you were pulled away I would lose my frame to stay
I'm defined by your mass
I remain where balance lies even skewed it still survives
Not as equal, not as free but consistent in its need
I don't know if I the way it bends I just follow where it ends
In the orbit I can see you are more than I can ever be
No escape, no demand just a curfew I understand
Not abandoned, not undone just the lesser of the suns
I'm the echo of a frame that was never set the same
I'm defined by your mass
